learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the engine of rural and semi-urban India! Learn about MSMEs, the spirit of entrepreneurship, and how startups are changing the landscape.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises. They are classified based on two criteria: Investment in Plant & Machinery/Equipment, and Annual Turnover. They are the backbone of the Indian economy, creating massive employment.
Small businesses generate employment (they use labor-intensive methods), help in rural development, reduce regional imbalances, and provide specialized or customized products.
A government initiative to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups in the country. It provides tax exemptions, simpler compliance, and funding support to new businesses.
Legal rights over creations of the mind. Includes Patents (for inventions), Trademarks (for logos/brand names), and Copyrights (for artistic/literary works). IPR protects innovators from theft.

fun_activity.title: ©️ Protect Your Idea!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you invent a flying skateboard. You get a PATENT for the technology. You name it 'SkyBoard' and get a TRADEMARK for the logo. You write an instruction manual and get a COPYRIGHT for the text. Now no one can steal your hard work!

exam_tips: 📌 Memorize the latest MSME classification limits (Micro: Investment < 1Cr, Turnover < 5Cr. Small: Inv < 10Cr, Turn < 50Cr. Medium: Inv < 50Cr, Turn < 250Cr).
📌 NSIC (National Small Industries Corporation) and DIC (District Industries Centers) are key institutions supporting small businesses—know their basic functions.
📌 Clearly distinguish between Patent (inventions), Copyright (art/books/music), and Trademark (brand identifiers).
quick_recap: ⭐ Entrepreneurship is the process of setting up a business, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.
⭐ Small businesses often struggle with a lack of adequate finance, outdated technology, and marketing problems.
⭐ IPR gives the creator an exclusive right over the use of his/her creation for a certain period of time.
